case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1555 OF 2022 (@ SLP (Crl.) No. 3411/2021)
summary: Abuse of process in invoking Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes Act; private civil dispute over temple construction/conversion to criminal proceedings; no prima facie case under Sections 3(1)(v) and (va); High Court reversal required for quashing proceedings under Section 482 Cr.P.C; criminal intimidation/construction obstruction claims dismissed as non-atrocity offenses.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(v)
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(va)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court judgment quashed; criminal proceedings and summons under Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes Act set aside as abuse of process.
